issues.explanation: In 臆病な, な is the attributive form of the copula, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to auxiliary; lemma だ and kana な are appropriate.

issues.explanation: After 形見, で is the continuative form of the copula linking the coordinated clothing descriptions, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to auxiliary; lemma だ, kana で; meaning "being; and".

issues.explanation: After 綿入れ, で is the continuative form of the copula before いつも同じだった, not a particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to auxiliary; lemma だ, kana で; meaning "being; and".

issues.explanation: This is ordinary compositional language: the noun/adverb 互い followed by the particle に.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 互い (lemma 互い, kana たがい, "each other") and に (particle, "mutually/to").

issues.explanation: The negative-volitional auxiliary まい attaches to the verb 負け; it should not be grouped as one auxiliary segment.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 負け (lemma 負ける, kana まけ, "lose") and まい (auxiliary, kana まい, "intend not to").

issues.explanation: In 猫だけでなく, this consists of copular で plus the continuative form なく of the negative auxiliary ない; it is not one particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into で (auxiliary, lemma だ, kana で) and なく (auxiliary, lemma ない, kana なく).

issues.explanation: でなく is labeled as a particle, although it contains copular and negative auxiliary morphology.
issues.suggested_fix: Use separate auxiliary segments で and なく, with meanings "being" and "not".

issues.explanation: 人目 means people's eyes, public notice, or others' attention; "public notice" is misleading here.
The construction だけでなく means "not only ... but also ..." and is missing from grammar_overlays.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an overlay spanning exactly だけでなく, describing the "not only" construction.

issues.explanation: 負けまいと expresses the sisters' determination or intention not to lose, and this genuine grammar construction is missing from grammar_overlays.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an overlay spanning exactly 負けまいと, describing "with the intention/determination not to lose".

issues.explanation: Here でも is compositional で plus the particle も, with で linking 上 to the concessive/topic phrase; it should not be grouped as one particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into で (particle or auxiliary according to the chosen analysis) and も (particle, "even/also").

issues.explanation: In 人間は公平の考えでは猫より上でも, でも contributes a concessive "even though/even if," but the annotation's single meaning is not attached to separable components.
issues.suggested_fix: After splitting, give で the linking/comparison meaning and も the concessive "even; although" meaning.

issues.explanation: のせいだ is a cause/blame construction meaning "because of the ..." and is not represented in grammar_overlays.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an overlay spanning exactly 性格のせいだ, describing the cause/blame expression.
